cards.ex: In my experience, trust is earned, not freely given.
cards.exUz: Mening tajribamga ko'ra, ishonch bepul berilmaydi, uni qozonish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishonch o'z-o'zidan kelmaydi, uni harakatlar va vaqt bilan qozonish kerak.

cards.ex: I have a grain of doubt about his story, but I can't quite put my finger on why.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyasiga nisbatan ozgina shubham bor, lekin nima uchunligini aniq ayta olmayman.

cards.ex: I'm offering you the partnership, but it's a case of take it or leave it.
cards.exUz: Men sizga sheriklikni taklif qilyapman, lekin bu uni ol yoki qo'y degani.

cards.ex: I suspected something amiss when I saw the office door open so late at night.
cards.exUz: Ofis eshigini kechasi ochiq ko'rganimda nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligini sezdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir g'alati yoki noto'g'ri ekanligini sezish.

cards.ex: A waft of suspicion surrounded the deal after the company's sudden stock drop.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning kutilmagan aksiya tushishidan so'ng, bitim atrofida shubha hidi paydo bo'ldi.

cards.ex: A leader must act with integrity to gain the respect of their team.
cards.exUz: Yetakchi jamoasining hurmatini qozonish uchun halol harakat qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Halol, vijdonli va axloqiy tamoyillarga rioya qilib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Remember, everyone is innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
cards.exUz: Esda tutingki, sud zalida aybi isbotlanmaguncha, har kim aybsizdir.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy tamoyil: ayb isbotlanmaguncha, har kim aybsiz hisoblanadi.

cards.ex: Their relationship was just a charade of trust to keep up appearances.
cards.exUz: Ularning munosabatlari faqat tashqi ko'rinishni saqlash uchun ishonch niqobi edi.

cards.ex: I don't take his promises on face value; I need to see results.
cards.exUz: Men uning va'dalarini sirtqi baholab qabul qilmayman, natijalarni ko'rishim kerak.

cards.ex: I cross my heart, I didn't tell anyone your secret.
cards.exUz: Qasam ichaman, sening siringni hech kimga aytmadim.

cards.ex: Sharing client data with competitors is a serious breach of confidence.
cards.exUz: Mijozlar ma'lumotlarini raqobatchilar bilan baham ko'rish - bu sirni oshkor qilishning jiddiy holati.

cards.ex: The initial success lulled us into complacency, and we missed the warning signs.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki muvaffaqiyat bizni xotirjamlikka undadi va biz ogohlantiruvchi belgilarni o'tkazib yubordik.

cards.ex: I trust my source completely; they've always been reliable in the past.
cards.exUz: Men manbamga to'liq ishonaman; ular doimo ishonchli bo'lgan.

cards.ex: They don't always see eye to eye, but they respect each other's opinions.
cards.exUz: Ular doimo fikrlari mos kelmasa ham, bir-birlarining fikrlarini hurmat qilishadi.

cards.ex: In business negotiations, it's often best to keep your cards close to your chest.
cards.exUz: Biznes muzokaralarida ko'pincha o'z rejalaringizni sir tutgan ma'qul.

cards.ex: After the investigation, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Tergovdan so'ng, u nihoyat beg'ubor edi.

cards.ex: I've been harboring suspicions about his behavior for a while now.
cards.exUz: Men bir muncha vaqtdan beri uning xatti-harakatlariga nisbatan shubhalarni saqlab kelmoqdaman.

cards.ex: In that family, loyalty runs deep, and they always support each other.
cards.exUz: O'sha oilada sadoqat chuqur ildiz otgan va ular doimo bir-birlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydilar.

cards.ex: I earnestly believe that she's telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Men uning rost gapirayotganiga chin dildan ishonaman.

cards.ex: Whether the new policy will work is still up in the air; the jury is out.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat ishlaydimi yoki yo'qmi hali aniq emas; natija hali noma'lum.

cards.ex: The way they're handling the situation smells like a cover-up.
cards.exUz: Ular vaziyatni qanday hal qilayotganlari nimadir yashirilayotganga o'xshaydi.

cards.ex: I'm going to give him enough rope to hang himself; he'll mess up eventually.
cards.exUz: Men unga o'zini osib qo'yish uchun yetarli imkoniyat beraman; u oxir-oqibat xato qiladi.

cards.ex: You need to be on your guard when dealing with that company; they're known for their tactics.
cards.exUz: Siz ushbu kompaniya bilan ishlashda hushyor bo'lishingiz kerak; ular o'z taktikasi bilan tanilgan.

cards.ex: In any relationship, honesty is paramount; without it, trust is impossible.
cards.exUz: Har qanday munosabatlarda halollik eng muhim; usiz ishonch imkonsizdir.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, she had unshakeable faith in her team's ability to succeed.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u o'z jamoasining muvaffaqiyatga erishish qobiliyatiga mustahkam ishonchga ega edi.

cards.ex: For many, betrayal cuts deep, and it's hard to forgive.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik uchun xiyonat juda og'ir botadi va uni kechirish qiyin.

cards.ex: There's still a shadow of doubt in my mind about his intentions.
cards.exUz: Uning niyatlariga nisbatan ongimda hali ham shubha soyasi bor.

cards.ex: The desperate are often vulnerable to manipulation by unscrupulous individuals.
cards.exUz: Umidsizlar ko'pincha vijdonsiz shaxslar tomonidan manipulyatsiyaga moyil bo'ladi.

cards.ex: He tried to fly under the radar and avoid attracting attention to himself.
cards.exUz: U sezilmasdan o'tishga va o'ziga e'tiborni jalb qilmaslikka harakat qildi.

cards.ex: He managed to win them over with his charm and intelligence.
cards.exUz: U o'zining jozibasi va aql-zakovati bilan ularni ko'ndirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir o'z fikriga ko'ndirmoq, ishonchini qozonmoq.
